protocol.application: 20 Hz pinhole stereo local odometry and mapping without loop closure; EuRoC is an engineering proxy, not road-driving validation
protocol.order: For each load and repetition rotate the three strategies; all comparisons serial
protocol.acceptance: Every replicate must satisfy the absolute quality/resource criteria; compare relative limits to native median at the same load. Fixed model gate additionally requires original trace reconstruction <=100 us in all windows. Complete this comparison batch even if a strategy fails; do not begin probability fitting on failure.
protocol.limitations: Predeclared research feasibility criteria, not automotive safety requirements. No live-camera, outdoor, RGB-D, fisheye or long-term closure validation. Companion is a periodic image-processing proxy, not actual planning or a perception network. No claim of statistical sample sufficiency.
